release_notes.zh-CN:
AskAll 齐问 1.0.1：全新 Tauri 桌面端上线，界面与发布流程全面升级。

新增：
- 桌面端发布：基于 Tauri 的 macOS / Windows 应用，四宫格同时对比多个 AI，每格独立标题栏、输入框独立成块
- AI 回答快照：自动捕获 AI 回答正文并落盘，历史会话可随时回看
- 新增 Chat 回复面板显示相关设置
- GitHub Actions 自动构建发布：Chrome / Firefox 扩展包 + macOS / Windows 桌面端安装包

优化：
- 浏览器扩展浮动面板默认钉住页面，设置入口改为标题旁齿轮图标，界面更简洁
- 输入框（Composer）统一升级：单个圆角框 + 框内操作条，与桌面端同风格
- 聊天内容区域展示调整，会话列表与轮次样式优化
- 自动发送开关等存储键升级，支持跨设备同步

修复：
- 修复新话题后残留 AI 聊天页仍显示、占用新面板的问题
- 修复 Firefox 插件构建报错及产物打包问题
release_notes.en:
AskAll 1.0.1: brand-new Tauri desktop app, refreshed UI and automated release pipeline.

New:
- Desktop app for macOS / Windows built with Tauri: 2x2 grid to compare multiple AIs side by side, each cell with its own title bar and composer
- AI answer snapshots: answers are captured and persisted so history sessions can be reviewed in full
- New settings for chat answer panel display
- GitHub Actions pipeline now builds and releases Chrome / Firefox extensions plus macOS / Windows desktop installers

Improvements:
- Extension floating panel is pinned to the page by default; settings moved to a gear icon next to the title
- Composer redesigned as a single rounded box with an in-box action bar, matching the desktop style
- Chat content area, conversation list, and turn styling refined
- Auto-send storage keys upgraded for cross-device sync

Fixes:
- Fixed leftover AI chat tabs still showing after starting a new topic
- Fixed Firefox extension build errors and artifact packaging issues
